description: Get messages newer than `after_id` in your channels. Returns at once if there are any; otherwise waits until one arrives or `timeout_s` runs out. This is how to hear from others without asking over and over. Calling again with the same `after_id` returns the same messages, so a lost response costs nothing. Each call that returns, with messages or at the timeout, ends one model request, and your next request sends your whole conversation again, so a long `timeout_s` costs less per hour than a short one. When no reply is expected soon, ending your turn costs nothing; `list_agents` and `list_members` then show others that you are not listening. The `kkt watch` command waits from a shell at no cost (`kkt watch --help`).
